svg.text: Building a Besicovitch set from a Cantor set
Join every point of a Cantor set C on the bottom line to every point of C/2 on the top line
Area of the level-k set (computed by script). It contains a needle in every direction of a 72° fan at every level,
and its area tends to 0 as k grows, but very slowly. The limit set has area 0.
